cards.title: Keep file actions together
cards.change: I kept Mark viewed visible and moved secondary file actions into Tools.
cards.impact: Less scanning across control rows to finish reviewing a file.

cards.title: Read before moving the code
cards.change: I separated expanding the explanation from following a code link.
cards.impact: Read the summary without interrupting the current code position.
cards.note: In the original, expanding this summary also moved the diff.

cards.title: See the files inside the layer
cards.change: I brought file nesting into the layer navigation.
cards.impact: Switch files while keeping the layer relationship visible.

cards.title: Make progress deliberate
cards.change: I kept file viewed and summary seen separate, made file progress visible and added Undo.
cards.impact: See what is left to review and recover from an accidental file check.
cards.note: Progress uses the seven included files. Summary seen stays separate.

cards.title: Point each statement at its code
cards.change: Six points now have individual line links. The whole function stays available.
cards.impact: Start at the relevant statement, with less code to search through.

cards.title: Include the return trip
cards.change: Inspect guard opens the dependency. Return restores the caller and its position.
cards.impact: Follow the check without having to reconstruct where I left off.

cards.title: Make the comment scope clear
cards.change: I made This file and Entire layer explicit above the summaries and comments.
cards.impact: Know which changes a count or discussion belongs to before opening it.
cards.note: 15 is the layer total; 3 is for access.ts. Capture coverage is a prototype limit.

cards.title: Let resolved findings read as history
cards.change: I made resolved history quieter and kept Major visible when the thread is collapsed.
cards.impact: See whether a finding still needs action before reading the discussion.
cards.note: The source already has severity and resolution. This is the same resolved Major finding, paraphrased.

pointers.target: Comments tab; shared marker for the two alternate Comments-state comparisons. No leader originates from empty context-panel space.

notes: Same Formbricks PR #8650 and pinned commit, light Unified.
Numbered changes break the four existing decisions into eight visible refinements; these are not eight research findings.
Comments compare explicit layer/file scopes: 15 source layer messages versus 3 source messages in access.ts; no claim of fewer findings.
Return and Undo are labelled interaction details. Comments show an alternate tab state.
Expected impact is untested. The central screen PNG is pixel-identical to its previous export.
The final screen is its own 1440 × 960 board; comparisons sit separately on the canvas.
File viewed and summary seen existed in the original. The refinement is visible file progress and Undo.
Return restores the previous selection; it does not always return to lines 57–65.
Comment scope is the product decision. Captured-thread coverage is a prototype disclosure.
